newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle says 1996 net won't match H1 growth.
newsitem.headline: Nestle says 1996 net won't match H1 growth.

text.p: Nestle SA said it did not expect full-year group net profit to grow at the same pace as in the first half, when net rose 20 percent to 1,347 million Swiss francs ($1.1 billion).

"The net profit growth rate registered during the first six months of of the year will not be sustained over the second semester, as its very favourable evolution is due to the comparison with a rather weak period during the first six months of 1995," it said in a statement.
It did not give a precise estimate for 1996 profit.
